name: A waterside house with potted plants along its balcony, and a Tanka boat
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a waterside dwelling flanked by wooden posts, with a row of potted plants; and a drawing (at 90 degrees) of a Tanka boat connected to the shore by a gangplank, with a figure beneath the rattan covering.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
